name: Ananya Iyer
headline: Senior Backend Engineer (Python)
summary: Backend engineer with 7 years of experience building payment and invoicing systems in Python. Comfortable owning a service end to end, from schema design to on-call.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
bullets: Own the order-management service in FastAPI, serving 2,500 requests per second with p99 latency under 120 ms.
Partitioned a 1.8 TB PostgreSQL orders table by month, cutting nightly vacuum time from 6 hours to 40 minutes.
Added Redis-backed rate limiting and idempotency keys after a duplicate-charge incident; repeat charges dropped to zero.
Moved 14 Python services from hand-managed EC2 hosts to Docker containers on AWS ECS with blue-green releases.
Raised pytest coverage on the payments module from 48% to 91% and made it a merge gate.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built REST APIs for invoice reconciliation with Django REST Framework, used by 300 small-business customers.
Moved PDF generation and bank-statement parsing onto Celery workers, keeping the web tier responsive during month-end peaks.
Designed PostgreSQL migrations for a multi-tenant schema serving 9,000 tenants without downtime.
Rewrote the Django admin for the finance operations team, cutting manual reconciliation time by 60%.

experience.title: Software Engineering Intern
bullets: Built an internal Flask tool for tagging support tickets, adopted by a 25-person support team.
Wrote Python scripts that de-duplicated 40,000 customer records.
Presented a latency dashboard prototype to the engineering leads at the end of the internship.
